versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the freight-pricing skill.
- Provides a unified response template for all international freight-related inquiries, directing users to contact a designated logistics specialist for accurate quotes and solutions.
- No actual freight rates or logistics plans are given; all queries receive the same contact information and request for cargo details.
- Knowledge explanations are only provided if the user explicitly asks for information without needing a quote.
- Internal expertise and workflow documentation included for future enhancements, but not shown to users at this stage.
